tool_input.description: Make both test classes use the cache-clearing base and run them
Make both test classes use the cache-clearing base and run them

result:
- **Cause:** Test-order pollution through the static `PriceCache`, not the `TryPriceOf` change. `PromotionTests.Promotion_ReducesPrice_WhileActive` leaves MUG cached at 10.00 (20% off) and never ends the promotion. `CatalogTests` did not clear the cache, so it read 10.00 whenever it ran after `PromotionTests`. Xping history agrees: the test is flagged known flaky, has also failed on `main` (1 of 10), and passes and fails on the same commit `e0e1b3d` on the same runners.

- **Action:** Test-only change in `tests/Storefront.Specs/CatalogTests.cs` and `tests/Storefront.Specs/PromotionTests.cs`. Both now inherit `StorefrontTestBase`, which clears `PriceCache` before each test, and use its `Catalog` instead of their own `_catalog` field. No production code changed.

The 11 Catalog, Promotion and PriceCache tests pass locally; I did not run the full suite. The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline won't go green until you push it.

Xping also flags `CarrierClientTests.CarrierClient_ReturnsQuote_FromSandbox` as broken since today. It wasn't in your failing job and I left it alone, but it could fail the next run.
